comment: 9yo female, asymptomatic, cascade testing positive for germline SDHB c.137G>A (p.Arg46Gln) pathogenic variant after father diagnosed with metastatic abdominal paraganglioma at age 31 (peri-aortic primary with retroperitoneal lymph node + bone metastases; on 177Lu-DOTATATE PRRT). No personal cancer diagnosis; normal pediatric growth + development; normal blood pressure on age-appropriate measurement. Pedigree contains pediatric onset (paternal aunt diagnosed paraganglioma at age 12) — meets criteria for earlier-baseline intensified surveillance. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = SDHB carrier surveillance — whole-body MRI annually from age 6-10 (currently within window; baseline scheduled now under age-appropriate sedation protocol) + plasma free metanephrines + methoxytyramine (3-MT) q12mo + head + neck MRI q2-3y + abdominal MRI annually consolidated with whole-body MRI + parental counselling re: pediatric MRI sedation + cascade testing for younger sibling; alternative = intensified track with q6mo biochemistry + annual 18F-FDG PET supplement given family-specific pediatric-onset proband (aunt age 12) + metastatic SDHB-PPGL pedigree (father). CRITICAL severity — SDHB is highest-risk SDHx subunit.
